summary:
Thank you for inviting us to your party. How are you both doing? How about coming by to visit us? Send us letter; give day and time; we will be here (unless dead or in jail). 

Hey—ever since your party I’ve been trying to remember where I met that chick Jill that Terry brought. It obsesses me, because there is no way I could have ever met her. Next time you see Terry or her, ask them. Okay? It’s driving me nuts. Para-amnesia, maybe; must be. But please ask. I can’t stand it. In other news, Doubleday just bought my new novel, FLOW MY TEARS, THE POLICEMAN SAID, and I wrote and sold a new story for Ferman for his anthology, FINAL—I forget, either STAGE OR EDGE. So I’m writing & selling again, I guess. 

Tessa and I plan to get married tomorrow. We’re getting the license today. I forget what else; I’m sort of nervous. Love, and please do come by ... oh, yes; MAN IN THE HIGH CASTLE has been bought in Germany. And also we’re flying to Poland in a year, paid for by royalties from there on UBIK. Will be speaking to and with the Polish Writers Union, all arranged by Lem, who will “take me in his personal self’ when we get there. Lem and I have been writ­ ing back and forth; I’m eager to meet him. The B.B.C. TV showed up and did a film sequence of me in my kitchen, a short scene from a novel of mine. Then an interview. The whole film with all the writers will be shown to us in LA. in June, I believe.
